script: My friend says I am the asshole, but I exposed Pedro's birthday betrayal!. I was at Emma's birthday dinner with Pedro, Faith, and Zoey. We'd already decided to skip it because money was tight—Emma and I had even talked about canceling. Pedro was the only one who cared, so when I said we couldn't afford it, he asked, "Are you asking me for money?" I said no, just explaining. He then said, "Use my new credit card; I need to hit the bonus." We both knew I'd pay him back Monday. We also split the bill: my meal and half of Emma's on his card. He'd drive me home after, too. (I am not even mad that he offered, but it was a win.) Faith was late, so we waited. Pedro, meanwhile, ordered three appetizers just for himself and ate them. When Faith finally showed up, we ordered, and Pedro even nudged Emma to add a caviar bump. I stepped outside for a smoke, right outside the only entrance. When I came back, Pedro was gone. Everyone thought he'd left to say goodbye, but he hadn't. I asked the waiter what Pedro had paid for. Only his own appetizers. If he'd left before we ordered, I'd just skip it. But he stayed, knew we'd split the bill, and left without a word. I couldn't call my boyfriend or parents for help, so I told Faith what happened. She offered to cover it, but after checking her bank she didn't have enough. We pooled what we had, paid the bill, and didn't even tip the waiter. Faith had to drive me home because Pedro was nowhere to be found. (I still feel bad about the tip, but that's life.) A few days later, Pedro calls me. "You're the asshole," he says, "because you felt entitled to my money." I tell him I thought he was the jerk: he proposed the split, stayed through ordering, then left without warning and only paid for himself, leaving me scrambling to cover my meal and ride. He laughs and calls me entitled. Am I the jerk? I am not the one who said no to the bill. I am not the one who ate more than his share. I am the one who kept the plan, paid the waiter, and didn't tip because we were broke. Pedro left us in the lurch. So, no, I am not the jerk. I am the one who kept my word and tried to salvage the night. Pedro? He's the one who didn't.
